## Behavior

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated behavioral tests for changed contracts.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] No credentials, tenant data, raw payloads, commands, file contents, or message contents are included.
- [ ] QM HTTP changes update the pinned contract suite and compatibility documentation.
- [ ] The change does not import, vendor, symlink, or add a file dependency on QM source.
- [ ] Configuration and authentication failures remain fail-closed.
